description: Discovered by real People.merge_persons regression while validating replica-owner presentation. Merging away a Person with a Replicated transcript raises Ecto.ConstraintError transcripts_owner_person_id_fkey from PersonMerger deletion. Current merge coordination handles legacy conversations/ratings but not transcript ownership. Needs explicit history ownership/collision policy preserving canonical UUIDs, placements, access and immutable source scope; do not disable constraints or fake old-owner fixtures. Reproduce with current API capture, then merge owner into another Person. Separate from name/link projection and generic Jido ratings. Existing owner remains resolvable; merged historical aliases are projection-only.

comments.text: Implemented Person-owned canonical history reconciliation in the existing People.merge_persons transaction. Conversations now plans/locks and applies Replicated transcript plus ExecutionRecord ownership transfers before loser deletion; current migration replay remains safe when those later tables do not yet exist. Replica UUIDs, scope keys, source identities, placements, and permission resources remain unchanged and separate. Post-merge new capture prefers the survivor canonical replica or deterministically continues a transferred replica; source replay resolves exact persisted placements and canonicalizes duplicate merged owners without restoring revoked grants. Capture takes Person key-share locks to coordinate deletion/merge. Regression-first coverage reproduces the original FK failure and verifies execution transfer, BO owner projection, loser-only continuation, overlapping/shared copies, outsider permission isolation, replay idempotency, and outer transaction rollback. Action reuse: extended People.merge_persons + Conversations canonical storage; existing PeopleGateway/UpdatePerson Action already route through it, so no new Action/tool/workflow operation. Validation: 181 tests +13 properties across merge/concurrency/email migration/history/admin/permissions/rating suites, zero failures; mix q and git diff --check pass. No commit/push.

title: [zaq-emb.27] Define Person merge handling for transcript owners
